title: Rotor
text: 计算气动力和力矩，输入 9 路、输出 4 路；按 {Units} 指定输入和输出单位 Metric；{Modeling} 指定旋翼推力计算方法 Without flap、{Include pitch angle inputs} 启用桨距角输入、{CT and CQ Source} 用于选择推力系数和扭矩系数值来源的下拉菜单、{Thrust coefficient (CT)} 指定推力系数、{Torque coefficient (CQ)} 指定扭矩系数 7.8263e-4、{Number of blades} 指定每个旋翼的叶片数、{Output computed CT and CQ} 输出计算得到的推力系数和扭矩系数、{Radius (m)} 指定旋翼半径、{Chord (m)} 指定叶片弦长、{Hinge offset (m)} 指定铰链偏移、{Lift curve slope (per rad)} 指定升力曲线斜率、{Mean drag coefficient} 指定平均阻力系数、{Lock number} 指定洛克数、{Twist distribution} 指定旋翼叶片扭转分布、{Blade root angle (rad)} 指定叶片根部桨距角、{Blade twist angle (rad)} 指定叶片扭转角、{Blade tip angle (rad)} 指定叶尖桨距角，按实例取值。

ports.name: V b
ports.summary: 旋翼的机体速度 3-by-1 vector | 1-by-3 vector

ports.name: θ c
ports.summary: 横向周期变距桨距角 scalar

ports.name: θ s
ports.summary: 纵向周期变距桨距角 scalar

ports.name: C T
ports.summary: 输入推力系数 nonzero positive scalar

ports.name: C Q
ports.summary: 输入转矩系数 nonzero positive scalar

ports.name: C T
ports.summary: 计算得出的推力系数 positive scalar

ports.name: C Q
ports.summary: 计算得出的转矩系数 positive scalar

params.name: Units
params.values: 输入和输出单位 Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Modeling
params.values: 旋翼推力计算方法 Without flap effects (default) | With flap effects

params.name: Include pitch angle inputs
params.values: 启用桨距角输入 off (default) | on

params.name: CT and CQ Source
params.values: 用于选择推力系数和扭矩系数值来源的下拉菜单 ’Dialog’ (default) | ’Compute using BEMT’ | ’Ports’

params.name: Thrust coefficient (CT)
params.values: 推力系数 0.0107 (default) | nonzero positive scalar

params.name: Torque coefficient (CQ)
params.values: 扭矩系数 7.8263e-4 (default) | nonzero positive scalar

params.name: Number of blades
params.values: 每个旋翼的叶片数 2 (default) | nonzero positive scalar

params.name: Output computed CT and CQ
params.values: 输出计算得到的推力系数和扭矩系数 off (default) | on

params.name: Radius (m)
params.values: 旋翼半径 0.0330 (default) | nonzero positive scalar

params.name: Chord (m)
params.values: 叶片弦长 0.0080 (default) | nonzero positive scalar

params.name: Lift curve slope (per rad)
params.values: 升力曲线斜率 5.5 (default) | nonzero positive scalar

params.name: Mean drag coefficient
params.values: 平均阻力系数 0 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Twist distribution
params.values: 旋翼叶片扭转分布 Linear (default) | Ideal

params.name: Blade root angle (rad)
params.values: 叶片根部桨距角 0.2548 (default) | real scalar
